description: A seekable media timeline with a thumb, a hover tooltip and chapters.

props.chapterGap: Width of the gap between chapters.
props.chapters: Chapter starts in seconds, each with an optional `title`. The bar is split at every start and the tooltip and announced value name the chapter.
props.readonly: Keeps the bar focusable and announced but ignores pointer and keyboard input.
props.step: Controls who far progress is moved by the arrow keys (in seconds). Holding Shift moves 10x as far, or pass `[step, shiftStep]` to set both. Page Up and Page Down move by a tenth of **max**.
props.thumb: Shows a thumb at the current position.
props.tooltip: Shows the time under the pointer while hovering. Pass an object to set `location` (`top` or `bottom`) and `offset` from the bar.
props.variant: `pill` applies the MD3 look: a bar-shaped **thumb** with a gap on both sides. `wavy` also draws the played part as a wave and eases jumps (clicks, keyboard seeks, start position), but not dragging or playback.

events.update:modelValue: Emitted with the new position in seconds while clicking, dragging or using the keyboard.

slots.tooltip: Replaces the contents of the hover tooltip. Receives the formatted time, the chapter title and the hovered position in seconds.
